title: Auto-Pay Bills
desc: Automate the routing of your fixed monthly rent and utilities.
to-teach: Automate fixed recurring bill payments from checking.
hints: Your Rent and Utilities expenses currently have no active transfer rules connected.
Route $1,200 to Rent and $300 to Utilities as automated fixed transfers from Checking.

client.name: Alex
client.description: Alex missed two utility due dates because bill payments required manual transfers every month.
client.prompt: I want my fixed bills to pay themselves immediately when my paycheck arrives in checking. How do I wire this up?
